implementation: Owning client alone scans the same middle ElectricField overlap/sweep; no pillar or remote pawn prediction
PredictedAutonomousOnly BounceBack action scheduled into existing Network Physics next local frame; no client hit/damage RPC
Authority independently scans, queues reliable action and applies GAS Stun/shocked/ball release; client never writes GAS or HP
Host-issued replicated PhysicsSourceId supports placed and dynamically spawned walls without Iris object hash

Local per-wall latch covers max(BounceBackSeconds,StunSeconds) plus scan interval and requires clear sample; prevents a correction crossing from becoming a second prediction
